name: i.safe MOBILE IS541.1
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS541.1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ia) smartphone from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 14, with 5G and a user-replaceable battery.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ia IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ia IIIC T135°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex ia IIC T4 Gb / Ex ia IIIC T135°C Db

safety.conditions: Battery charged and replaced only outside hazardous areas; USB connection (≤5 V SELV/PELV/ES1, Um ≤ 5.88 V) only outside hazardous areas; protect from high impact energy, UV and high electrostatic charge; USB-C and ISM covers closed in hazardous areas (IECEx EPS 25.0059X).

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Supports 450 MHz LTE, used by private utility networks
limitations: T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
